command.name: Set IP Parameters Address
command.description: Sets the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway for the meter's Ethernet interface.
command.user_notes: This is applicable for meters having Ethernet as only communication Interface

parameters.name: Command Semaphore
parameters.description: A non-zero value triggers the command execution.

parameters.name: IP Address Part 1
parameters.description: First two octets of the IP address.

parsing.description: First two octets of the IP address. xxx.-.-.-
Last two octets of the IP address. -.xxx.-.-

parameters.name: IP Address Part 2
parameters.description: Last two octets of the IP address.

parsing.description: Last two octets of the IP address. -.-.xxx.-
Last octet of the IP address. -.-.-.xxx

parameters.name: Subnet Mask Part 1
parameters.description: First two octets of the subnet mask.

parsing.description: first octet from left of the subnet mask. xxx.-.-.-
second octet from left of the subnet mask. -.xxx.-.-

parameters.name: Subnet Mask Part 2
parameters.description: third octet from left of the subnet mask. -.xxx.-.-

parsing.description: third octet from left of the subnet mask. -.xxx.-.-
last octet from left of the subnet mask. -.-.-.xxx

parameters.name: Gateway Part 1
parameters.description: first octet from left of the gateway address. xxx.-.-.-
